summary: A placeholder for a view with nothing to show yet: optional media, title, description and actions (a family of Web Components).

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.notes: The host is a centered column; its parts are child elements. A border is added by the consumer (for example a dashed border).

accessibility.accessibleNameSource: None. The title is a visual heading; use a real heading element inside sb-empty-title when it belongs in the document outline.
aria: no roles or ARIA on any element
decorative media is marked aria-hidden by the author
description links are underlined, so they do not rely on color (WCAG 1.4.1)

coverage: centered column, gap, padding 24px / 48px from 768px, radius
header and content max 48ch, centered, gaps
icon media: 40px muted rounded square, 24px svg
primary media has no box; variant reflects and updates
title and description typography and colors in light and dark
description links underlined, primary on hover

drift.realization: shadcn uses tracking-tight; no letter-spacing token exists
reference uses max-w-sm (24rem); the size scale has no measure token, so the measure is set in characters
shadcn docs add border-dashed plus a border class on the root

drift.contract: Hover color of a link in the description.
drift.realization: A link inside the text; the sample has none. Text formatting on a property-bound label is shared by every variant in Figma (tool-mapping), so link underlines stay in code.

drift.contract: Underline offset of a link in the description.
drift.realization: A link inside the text; the sample has none. Text formatting on a property-bound label is shared by every variant in Figma (tool-mapping), so link underlines stay in code.
A wider-viewport value (media query); the design file draws the narrow value, viewports are not an axis.

openQuestions.question: Border on the root (the docs use border-dashed with a border class)?
openQuestions.recommendation: No built-in border: the consumer styles the host (border: 1px dashed ...). Keeps the root a pure layout container.

openQuestions.question: Responsive padding (md:p-12) without Tailwind breakpoints?
openQuestions.recommendation: A min-width media query at 48em switches padding to empty.padding-lg.

elements.summary: Centers the media, title and description in a column no wider than 48 characters.
The illustration or icon above the title. The icon variant puts it in a 40px muted rounded square.

variant.note: primary: no box, the media is shown as is. icon: 40px muted square, 24px svg.

default.notes: An svg, image or avatar. Decorative media should be aria-hidden.

elements.summary: What is empty, in 18px medium weight.
One or two sentences saying why and what to do next. Direct child links are underlined.
The actions below the header, as a centered column (buttons, links, a small form).

useCases.when: A list, table or search has no content yet
useCases.use: sb-empty with an icon media, a title, a description and one primary action
sb-empty-title naming the query, a description with a link to clear filters

antiPatterns.pattern: Empty state with no way forward
antiPatterns.why: People are left at a dead end
antiPatterns.alternative: Add a sb-empty-content action or a link in the description

antiPatterns.why: An error needs an announced, assertive message
